tasks.short: Create photographic, video and audio data records for social research.

steps.what: Capture actual photographs, video or audio with participant permissions and research context
outputs: actual recorded media and researcher-produced contextual observations

steps.what: Create data-record metadata using native project identifiers and verified media fields
inputs: actual recorded media and researcher-produced contextual observations
actual project identifier and checked file timestamp

steps.what: Describe actual social context and choose analytical annotations without inferred participant beliefs
inputs: actual researcher observations and permitted participant context
outputs: actual chosen social-context descriptions and annotations

steps.what: Check complete final data records, media linkage, permissions and storage access
inputs: actual chosen social-context descriptions and annotations
outputs: checked final media data records and permitted storage destination

steps.what: Commit final permitted photographic, video and audio data records
inputs: checked final media data records and permitted storage destination

tasks.design: Configure native project/media fields in research data records {DATA_PLATFORM}, using actual camera/audio-recording software {OTHER} only as the media producer. Retain actual recording, contextual description and complete permission/linkage checking before separate record commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Media records can repeat project and file-identification fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata fields can reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Context, permissions and social interpretation cannot be inferred from file metadata.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher distinguishes an observable event from an unsupported interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research metadata fields can reduce repeated entry; actual ethnographic capture and contextual interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Researcher produces media/context in s1 and verifies timestamp/timezone, file identity and project linkage; missing or inaccurate metadata requires manual correction. No automatic transcription, participant identity or cultural inference assumed.

Existing metadata prefill earns zero new saving. No public release implied; any actual sharing is separately gated on exact final media, permitted recipients and permissions. No synthetic research data.
unknowns: Which verified metadata fields are currently retyped?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce entry after complete contextual and permission checks?

incremental.description: Maintain verified media/project field mapping and permitted access.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final media records, linked files and permitted storage/access destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.40=8 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All actual capture, interpretation, checking and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train others to apply ethnographic research methods to organisational problems.

steps.what: Choose ethnographic training methods and examples for actual organisational problems
inputs: actual learner needs and organisational problems

steps.what: Assemble and check training materials using native selected method sections
Save checked final ethnographic training materials
Train others through actual ethnographic exercises, explanation and feedback
outputs: actual training and observed learning outcomes

steps.what: Capture and check actual assigned training outcome record
inputs: actual training and observed learning outcomes
outputs: checked final actual training outcome record

steps.what: Save final actual training outcome record
inputs: checked final actual training outcome record

tasks.design: Configure reusable ethnographic method sections in {DOCS} and {LMS}, retaining actual selection and full material checking before a separate save. Actual training and outcome capture occur afterwards, with a distinct final outcome-record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected method sections can require repeated material assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable sections can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Applying ethnography to a real organisational problem requires contextual teaching.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher recognises when a learner's method would distort participant meaning.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable method sections can support training preparation; actual teaching and competence assessment remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Savings only repeated section assembly; all new content, full checking and actual teaching retained. Existing reuse earns zero saving.

Outcome record only where assigned, based on actual observed practice after training; omit unused branch and reweight. Any actual enrolment or material delivery is a separate pre-training final-version action with no saving assumed.
unknowns: Which training sections are actually reused?
research_questions: Does native reuse reduce preparation after full contextual checking?

approvals.approved_version: s2 exact final training materials and destination; edits void check
s5 exact final actual outcome record and destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.40=8 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual teaching, new outcomes and save actions retained.

tasks.short: Identify cultural beliefs and practices affecting health and service access.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify permitted community studies and actual health/service-access source records
inputs: actual permitted community studies and public-health records
outputs: verified source context and full substantive reading

steps.what: Obtain actual community perspectives and observations with appropriate permissions
inputs: verified source context and full substantive reading
actual community participants and agreed research permissions
outputs: actual participant accounts and researcher observations

steps.what: Identify culturally specific beliefs and practices affecting health status and access to services
inputs: actual participant accounts and researcher observations
verified source context and full substantive reading

steps.what: Collaborate with actual medical and public-health officials to test interpretations
inputs: actual official expertise and community context

steps.what: Capture and check actual qualified cultural findings and permitted record access
outputs: checked final actual cultural findings record

steps.what: Save final permitted cultural findings record
inputs: checked final actual cultural findings record

tasks.design: Configure native permitted-study links in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}, reducing navigation while retaining substantive reading. Keep actual community inquiry, cultural interpretation, official collaboration and new findings capture/check before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant permitted sources can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed source links can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Beliefs, health and access cannot be inferred from population labels.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher identifies an interpretation that stereotypes a diverse community.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation before actual cultural research.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research links can assist retrieval; cultural interpretation and community collaboration require actual evidence.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Source owners provide actual permitted records, researcher performs full reading and captures actual accounts. Existing source links earn zero saving. No synthetic participants or inferred beliefs.

Findings record only if actually required; omit unused branch and reweight. Any actual written advice/report delivery to officials is separately final-version gated, with actual disclosure permissions and no saving assumed.
unknowns: Which studies and community permissions are available?
research_questions: Which source-navigation work repeats without reducing substantive reading?

incremental.description: Maintain permitted study links and access.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final cultural findings record and permitted destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual inquiry, interpretation, collaboration and new record retained.

tasks.short: Apply ecological knowledge and cultural institutions to habitat/resource conflict resolution.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify permitted traditional ecological knowledge and land/resource institution source materials
inputs: actual community-authorised knowledge and institution records

steps.what: Interpret traditional ecological knowledge with actual knowledge holders and permissions
inputs: actual knowledge-holder accounts and use restrictions

steps.what: Assess culturally distinctive land and resource management institutions against actual conflict
inputs: actual institution practices and conflict facts

steps.what: Apply actual ecological knowledge and assessments to assist habitat/resource conflict resolution
inputs: actual parties, permissions and conflict conditions
outputs: actual resolution assistance and agreed or unresolved points

steps.what: Capture and check actual assigned assessment and resolution-assistance notes with use restrictions
inputs: actual resolution assistance and agreed or unresolved points

steps.what: Save final permitted assessment and assistance notes

tasks.design: Configure native links to community-authorised knowledge and institution records in {DOCS}. Retain full reading, knowledge-holder engagement, institutional assessment, actual conflict assistance and new assigned notes before separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permitted source retrieval can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed links can reduce source lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Knowledge authority, cultural context and conflicting interests require actual engagement.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher recognises that access to a source does not permit every use of its knowledge.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation before actual ecological and institutional interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links can assist permitted retrieval; knowledge interpretation and conflict resolution require actual participants and evidence.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual knowledge holders/record owners produce permitted materials; researcher verifies and fully reads them. Existing links yield zero saving. No automated cultural inference.

Notes only where assigned; omit absent branch and reweight. A discussion does not establish agreement or enact a land/resource decision. Any actual written recommendation delivery or agreement commitment is separately final-version gated with no saving assumed.

incremental.description: Maintain authorised knowledge/institution links and access.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final permitted assessment/assistance notes and destination; edits void check
